nn_state_extractor <- function(text) {
  match_info <- gregexpr("state\\s*=\\s*([^,^\\)]+)", text)
  matched_strings <- regmatches(text, match_info)[[1]]
  states <- gsub("state\\s*=\\s*", "", matched_strings)
